items.difficulty_reason: 47 行、四步：①direct-image-coherent ⇒ Rf_*E ∈ D^b_Coh ⇒ pseudo-coherent（Noetherian 判别）；②perfect ⇔ 有限 tor 维数，用 tor-qc-qs 的「与一切拟凝聚层张量后上同调一致有界」判据；③支撑并集 T proper over S ⇒ 取含 T 的拟紧开 X'（E 在 T 外为零）⇒ 换成拟紧拟分离情形；④基交换改写 ⊗ 进推前内部，相对 tor 维数给 [a,b] 有限范围 ⇒ 推后 [a,∞) 一致有界。承重的支撑归约与张量改写都在 span 内；8 处引用（4 同章、4 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-perfect-direct-image (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 6989-6999

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the reduction of perfectness to pseudo-coherence plus finite tor dimension, the tor dimension criterion by tensoring with quasi-coherent sheaves, the restriction to a quasi-compact open containing the proper support, the base change rewriting of the tensor with the pushforward, and the boundedness conclusion from the relative tor dimension assumption (source lines 7001-7035)
